description: Team chat and business communication software with messaging, channels, meetings, and workflow automation.
auth_notes: Zoho uses OAuth 2.0 via the Zoho Developer Console for authentication and generating access tokens for API requests.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Zoho account and use the Zoho API Console self-serve at no cost to register apps and obtain credentials.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST APIs covering chats, channels, messages, bots, and custom extensions/integrations.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Zoho; community alternatives may exist.
rationale: Zoho Cliq offers a fully documented public REST API and self-serve free developer credentials via the Zoho API Console.

evidence.note: Main Zoho Cliq product page outlining collaboration features and API capabilities.
Pricing page detailing free plans and developer platform access levels.
